questions.questionHtml:
If x3/2 + y3/2 + z3/2 = 3(xyz)1/2 and √x + √y + √z ≠ 0, what is the value of (x + y + z)/(2√(xy) + 2√(yz)+ 2√(zx))?

यदि x3/2 + y3/2 + z3/2 = 3(xyz)1/2 तथा √x + √y + √z ≠ 0, तो (x + y + z)/(2√(xy) + 2√(yz)+ 2√(zx)) का मान क्या है?
questions.solution:
x3/2 + y3/2 + z3/2 = 3(xyz)1/2

=>(√x)3 + (√y)3 + (√z)3 − 3√x√y√z = 0

=>(√x + √y + √z)((√x)2 + (√y)2 + (√z)2 − √x√y − √y√z − √z√x) = 0

Since, √x + √y + √z ≠ 0

∴(√x)2 + (√y)2 + (√z)2 − √x√y − √y√z − √z√x = 0

=>x + y + z = √(xy) + √(yz) + √(zx)

=>(x + y + z)/(2√(xy) + 2√(yz) + 2√(zx)) = 1/2

If 2x + y - 3z = 0, then find the value of 
4x2 + y2 + 9z2_________9z2 - 2xy

यदि 2x + y - 3z = 0 है, तो
4x2 + y2 + 9z2_________9z2 - 2xy
का मान ज्ञात कीजिये।
questions.solution:
2x + y - 3z = 0

=> (2x + y)2 = (3z)2

=> 4x2 + 4xy + y2 = 9z2

=> 4x2 + y2 + 9z2 = 18z2 - 4xy

=> (4x2 + y2 + 9z2)/(9z2 - 2xy) = 2
